title: Three Women on Porch, 1910s Sepia Snapshot, House 1130
description: A clear 1910s sepia snapshot depicting three women standing on the porch steps of a home numbered 1130. The women showcase classic Edwardian era fashion, including a Gibson Girl hair style, high-necked blouse, long tailored skirts, a broad-brimmed hat, and lace-up boots, providing a glimpse into early 20th-century American domestic fashion and lifestyle.
